body:
Application to amend zoning for 85-89 Columbia St. W. and 300 Hemlock St.
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this development before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
MHBC Planning advanced a zoning application to support an 8-storey mixed-use building with a height of 27.5 metres.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include :
build a tower set back 2.0 metres above the planned podium where a minimum of 3.0 metres is required
allow balconies of the tower to extend and align with the podium façade
allow parking around the building and not just behind it
View the documents submitted by the development company under Supporting Documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Building height: 8 storeys
Number of residential units: 136 one-bedroom and 1 two-bedroom units
Non-residential units
Four commercial units with a total floor area of 309.6 square metres
Parking
Parking: 77
Bicycle parking: 38
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the Planning Department.
